entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about an order. I... I need to make a return.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Sterling. Order number VF77812.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloPro Carbon cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?

They're just... not working for me. I was so excited to get them, but they're causing terrible blisters on my heels, no matter what socks I wear. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, thinking maybe my foot position was off, but nothing helps. It's just really disappointing.
I'm so sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see the shoes were delivered 34 days ago.

Oh... I know it's been a month. I kept trying to make them work. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these. I really needed this money back if they weren't going to work out. I hope it's not too late.

I completely understand, Mark. Let me just confirm our policy here... One moment... Okay, I've checked, and you have nothing to worry about. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That is such a relief. I was so worried.
Not at all. Since you're well within the 90-day window, we can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now.

You're welcome. Just be sure to pack up the cycling shoes in their original box. Once our warehouse receives them, we'll process your full refund. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mark?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help, Diana. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
